name: Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳市创想三维科技股份有限公司)
summary: Founded 2014 in Shenzhen and one of the largest consumer FDM hardware makers in the world (Ender, CR, K-series, Sermoon, HALOT resin). Unlike most printer brands, Creality extrudes its own filament in-house at scale and also acts as the OEM behind the Soleyin filament label. Catalog spans budget commodity PLA through Hyper high-speed lines and filled specialty variants.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md: Soleyin-branded filament is manufactured by Creality. Soleyin is a minor label with no independent catalog presence, so it is recorded here rather than as its own entry.
Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md: Comgrow resells Creality filament.

product_lines.name: Standard
product_lines.notes: Commodity lines priced around $15-20/kg for PLA

product_lines.name: Hyper Series
product_lines.notes: High-speed formulations tuned for Creality's K-series and other fast printers

product_lines.name: Specialty / filled
product_lines.notes: Wood-filled and carbon-fiber-filled variants plus PVA support; exact SKU list unverified

additional_notes: Manufacturing referenced across Shenzhen, Wuhan and Huizhou facilities. Vertically integrated: no evidence found that Creality outsources its own-brand filament to a third party. Sells an extensive line of PEI, glass and spring-steel build plates as printer accessories and spares. Corporate strategy publicly described as 'One Core with Two Wings' (printers plus ecosystem and cloud). Stock-listing status has been publicly discussed but specifics are unverified.

provenance.conflicts: Creality's listing/IPO status is discussed in secondary sources without confirmable specifics. Exact filament SKU list per material family could not be fully enumerated from primary sources.
